verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs state that it simplifies domain management and lets you add unique custom domains, even for different versions of a project. The REST API covers DNS management, automatic HTTPS secures the domains, and a community user independently confirms custom domains with SSL. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on DNS setup and verification steps, and detail on CLI/API domain attachment workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach custom domains to my deployed services

citations.quote: Simplify domain management for your projects and add unique custom domains for different versions of your project.
Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API
